title: Finite weighted-conjugation envelope advances a two-orientation Q3 algebraic subgate
question: Does a two-orientation weighted-conjugation envelope supply a non-Leibniz/state-weighted algebraic subgate for the Q3 common-alpha route, and is the reverse orientation genuinely necessary?
method: Run the SymPy primary exact lane on K=diag(1,4,9), S=diag(1,2,3), a rational 3D orthogonal fixture and exact principal-minor checks.
Run a non-importing standard-library Fraction lane with independently implemented matrix multiplication, determinants, principal minors and Frobenius rows.
Require primary/independent agreement on the two-orientation bound, finite envelope status, open thermodynamic status and the omitted-orientation witness.
Kernel-compile verification/lean/Tect/R207.lean with the pinned Lake toolchain for the generic conjugation multiplication, unit and inverse identities.

Apply adversarial checks against finite-fixture-to-operator promotion, one-sided form omission, sample-to-uniform norm promotion, scalar-product-to-limit promotion, Lean overreach and QFT-to-TECT promotion.
Keep the QFT-to-TECT firewall: the package contains no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner or physical reference.
finding: Primary 40/40, independent 35/35 and integrated 21/21 pass. The exact finite fixture satisfies both orientation form bounds at M=6 and the product/symmetric-carrier checks. With only the first orientation at M=4, the reverse margin has the exact negative witness -121/125. Lean R207 compiles successfully and checks the generic monoid identities.
decision_reason: The two-orientation weighted-conjugation construction is a reusable finite algebraic lemma candidate for the open non-Leibniz/state-weighted Q3 route. It does not establish the actual unbounded Q3 common core, induced norm, all-shape exhaustion Cauchy estimate, common alpha, KMS identification, ground state, GNS gap or continuum.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite algebraic/provenance checkpoint only. It does not close the Q3 common-alpha gate, prove a thermodynamic dynamics, identify common-alpha KMS states, establish a ground state or GNS/physical gap, remove a regulator, establish C6, Sector A or Pre-A, or supply the TECT production owner.

adversarial_review.check: The 3x3 rational matrices witness only a finite exact model; no unbounded-domain or infinite-volume theorem is inferred.
The reverse-oriented form margin with M=4 has a negative principal witness -121/125.
The executable norm rows are finite witnesses; they do not replace an induced-norm proof on the declared common core.
The scalar product comparison is finite and does not supply volume-independent exhaustion summability.
R207 kernel-checks only the monoid algebra identities and cannot prove the analytic QFT route.
No heat_root_incidence or canonical TECT production map appears in the package.
The finite envelope leaves exhaustion compatibility, strong-star convergence, invariant Hamiltonian algebra and KMS identification open.

qft_interface.closed: A finite algebraic/state-weighted subgate and a concrete two-orientation necessity witness are reproducible.
qft_interface.open: The all-bond Q3 graph-Lipschitz estimate, compatible exhaustion Cauchy theorem, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS identification, ground states, GNS gap and continuum remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This package does not identify heat_root_incidence, the canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical empty space or any Sector-A closure.

next_action: Use the envelope only as a lemma candidate: prove a common-core induced-norm bound for the actual Q3 bond and onsite factors, then prove all-shape exhaustion Cauchy and only afterward attempt common-alpha KMS identification.
